title: Responsive Web Design Certification
description: Learn the basics of HTML5 and CSS3 to build responsive, accessible web layouts. Covers flexbox, CSS grid, media queries, and semantic markup.

title: The Odin Project - Foundations
description: A comprehensive open-source curriculum for absolute beginners to learn full-stack web development. Covers Git, basic HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Harvard's legendary entry-level computer science course. Teaches critical thinking, algorithms, data structures, memory management using C, Python, SQL, and Web Development.

title: MDN JavaScript Guide
description: The definitive resource for learning modern JavaScript (ES6+). Highly descriptive docs covering prototype-based OOP, async functions, promises, DOM API, and event loop.

title: Scientific Computing with Python Certification
description: Master basic Python logic, loops, file operations, algorithms, and build several utility calculators and code challenges.

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
description: Jeremy Howard's world-famous fast.ai course teaching deep learning algorithms from a top-down, code-first perspective using PyTorch and fastai libraries.

title: Python for Data Analysis - 3rd Edition
description: Interactive notebook tutorials by Wes McKinney, creator of Pandas, covering data parsing, cleaning, plotting with matplotlib, numpy, and structuring clean pipelines.

title: Full Stack Open
description: University of Helsinki's course teaching modern JavaScript-based web development. Covers React, Redux, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, GraphQL, TypeScript, and Docker.

title: Learn Git Branching
description: An interactive, visual game teaching Git version control branch merging, rebasing, cherry-picking, and remote repository integration.

title: Kaggle Learn: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: A rapid, practical introduction to framing ML goals, building Random Forest and Decision Tree models using scikit-learn, and validation strategies.

title: FastAPI Official Tutorial
description: Comprehensive guide to building production-grade asynchronous web APIs with Python. Teaches Pydantic validation, dependency injection, OAuth2 security, and auto docs.

title: NeetCode 150 - Roadmap
description: Curated list of 150 LeetCode problems covering arrays, binary search, trees, graphs, backtracking, and dynamic programming with step-by-step video explanations.

title: Docker Curriculum
description: A comprehensive, easy-to-follow guide for getting started with Docker containers, multi-container setups, Docker Compose, AWS Elastic Beanstalk deployment, and CI/CD.

title: SQLBolt: Learn SQL
description: An interactive series of lessons and exercises designed to help you quickly learn and practice SQL queries in the browser. Covers SELECT, JOINs, and aggregates.

title: PostgreSQL Tutorial for Beginners
description: Deep dive into Postgres features, database creation, triggers, constraints, advanced indexing, optimization, window functions, and scaling strategies.

title: Machine Learning Zoomcamp
description: A free engineering-focused machine learning course by Alexey Grigorev. Covers regression, classification, evaluation metrics, deep learning, Kubernetes deployment, and MLOps.

title: React.dev - Modern Documentation
description: The official React tutorial and documentation site rewritten with modern hooks-based patterns. Teaches state management, effects, custom hooks, and React performance.

title: Kubernetes Web Academy
description: Free, curated video tutorials explaining Kubernetes containers, pod orchestration, architecture, networking, service mesh, ingress controllers, and Helm charts.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms in Python
description: Free interactive interactive visual textbook teaching stacks, queues, linked lists, hash tables, search algorithms, sorting algorithms, and complexity analysis.

title: AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials
description: Official free foundational AWS course covering cloud concepts, core AWS security services, global infrastructure, compute, networking, and billing details.
